title: calendar.*
description: Payload of a `calendar.new`, `calendar.modified`, `calendar.rescheduled` or `calendar.cancellation` event on the `calendar` stream. The meeting fields are the calendar-log.json meeting shape (id, title, start, end, attendees, hangoutLink) so a consumer that reads either sees the same keys. `change_type` repeats the event type in words.

id.description: Provider event id (Google event id, Exchange immutable event id).

change_type.description: created -> calendar.new, updated -> calendar.modified, rescheduled -> calendar.rescheduled, cancelled -> calendar.cancellation.

start.description: ISO 8601 date-time (UTC) or, for an all-day event, a date. Empty when a removed event can no longer be read.

hangoutLink.description: The online-meeting join URL (Google Meet, Microsoft Teams), or empty.
